_comment: Curated stand-in for a live scrape: realistic, well-performing, ORIGINAL outdoors-humour sticker concepts in the Mildly Outdoorsy voice. Metadata (reviews/rating/carts/BSR) is representative, not lifted from real listings. The last three entries intentionally contain protected IP so the copyright/trademark screen visibly drops them. `raw.alt_copy` and `raw.style` are hand-authored so the demo output is high quality; the pipeline falls back to its own paraphraser when they're absent.
